impactTab.title: Circular Agriculture Impact
impactTab.description: Store contribution metrics in recycling agricultural waste and supporting eco-friendly farming.
impactTab.recycledWasteDesc: Total estimated weight of organic & agricultural waste recycled into high-value commodities.
impactTab.organicProductsDesc: Number of eco-friendly & organic fertilizer product catalogs active in your storefront.
impactTab.farmersHelpedDesc: Farmer partners & customers supported through the circular agricultural supply chain.
impactTab.highlightBannerDesc: Your store actively reduces carbon emissions & discarded waste by turning crop residue into high economic value products for farming communities.

infoTab.title: Store Main Identity & Information
infoTab.description: Configure official logo, display name, domain slug URL, and public store bio
infoTab.logoHint: JPG, PNG, or WEBP format (max 5MB). Square 1:1 ratio logo works best.
infoTab.storeSlugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-) without spaces.
infoTab.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe your store's commitment, agricultural commodities, or processed waste products...

locationTab.title: Contact & Shipping Origin Address
locationTab.description: Warehouse or physical store location used by shipping couriers to calculate delivery rates
locationTab.phoneHint: Active contact number for order confirmation and courier pickup coordination
locationTab.addressPlaceholder: Street name, building number, RT/RW, District, Village

socialTab.title: Social Media & External Links
socialTab.description: Connect your promotion channels & social accounts to increase buyer trust
socialTab.whatsappHint: WhatsApp number used when buyers click Chat Seller
socialTab.instagramHint: Official Instagram profile link of your store
socialTab.tiktokHint: TikTok account for product demo videos & agricultural education
socialTab.websiteHint: Official website or farm portfolio link
socialTab.youtubeHint: Link to farm, orchard, or waste processing channel videos

policyTab.title: Operating Hours & Service Standards
policyTab.description: Store operational schedule and agricultural product quality commitments
policyTab.hoursDesc: Store actively processes orders Monday - Saturday 08.00 - 17.00 WIB. Orders after operating hours are processed next business day.
policyTab.packagingDesc: All commodities and processed goods are securely packaged using moisture-resistant and protective distribution packaging.
policyTab.guaranteeDesc: Your store is protected by Loop Tani escrow. Buyers get return guarantee if products do not match specifications.
